explain.what: US market holiday or early close.
explain.why: Thin liquidity: wider spreads, erratic moves, and futures may trade a shortened session.

explain.what: Weekly count of new unemployment-benefit filings (Thursdays 08:30 ET).
explain.why: The most timely labour-market read; usually a small mover unless it jumps, which flags a turn in the cycle.

explain.what: Treasury sells new debt; results (yield, bid-to-cover, tail) land ~13:01 ET.
explain.why: A weak long-bond auction lifts yields and can knock equities in the early afternoon; strong demand does the reverse.
